thread:
Alex: Heads-up — starting prod deploy window in ~10m. Canary then gradual traffic shift. Tagging `v3.6.0-rc2` and pinning inference runtime. @oncall please standby :eyes:
DeployBot: PROD deploy STARTED · env=prod · region=us-west-2 · commit=8f3b2a19 · tag=v3.6.0-rc2 · mode=canary · ttl=30m
Sam: any DB migrations?
Priya: no migrations in this rollout, just config and runtime pin. Feature flags already toggled in staging.
Jules: noted — running quick smoke after canary. will post results.
DeployBot: Canary instances up (3/3) · checks: smoke=running · routing=10%
Jules: smoke: logs look clean, latencies within SLO (~85ms p95). no errors in auth or cache. :thumbsup:
Alex: ok, proceeding to gradual 50% shift over next 4m. alerting on error-rate + latency spike.
DeployBot: Traffic shift to 50% · rollout-step=2/4 · routing=50% · health=passing
Sam: seeing a couple 5xx spikes in worker-x for a minute, but dropped back down. keeping an eye.
Priya: if it flares, we can fallback to `v3.6.0-rc1` — ready to pin and rollback if needed.
Alex: agreed. hold on rollback unless >1% error or >2x latency p95 for 3 consecutive mins.
DeployBot: Traffic shift complete · routing=100% · rollout-step=4/4 · health=passing · metrics: errors=0.08% · p95=92ms
Jules: post-deploy smoke run clean. synthetic checks green.
Alex: thanks team — promoting tag to prod stable in release notes. tagging commit in repo: `git tag -a v3.6.0 -m "prod release" 8f3b2a19`
DeployBot: PROD deploy COMPLETE · env=prod · region=us-west-2 · commit=8f3b2a19 · tag=v3.6.0-rc2 · duration=00:11:36 · outcome=success · notes="canary->full shift, no rollback required" :shipit:
Sam: adding rollout summary to the release doc and marking incidents none.
Priya: will schedule postmortem perf check tomorrow to validate cost/regressions.
Alex: nice job — thanks everyone.
DeployBot: logs and artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-deploys/prod/4123456799/ · traces attached
Jules: arch note — pinned inference runtime to `rt-2026-03-21` as planned. leaving a config diff in the PR.
Alex: closing the window. :white_check_mark:
